title: [3.0 RC1] Separate entry of carbohydrates not possible.
symptom: When entering carbohydrates separately, the message 'Bolus cannot be delivered' is displayed and the action can only be cancelled; no carbohydrates are added. However, entering carbohydrates via the bolus calculator worked.
evidence_quote: When entering carbohydrates, the message "Bolus cannot be delivered" is displayed and you can only cancel the action. No carbohydrates are then added.
